title: MODE 6-1: Edit
summary: Open a program slot (P1–P4) to author or modify commands. A new unused slot also asks for the program’s run mode.

body.text: Press MODE 6 → 1, then select slot 1–4. Enter statements from the keypad and SHIFT 3 (P-CMD). AC leaves editing.

Choosing an unused slot opens a run-mode menu. Screen 1: 1 COMP, 2 CMPLX. Press ▶ for screen 2: 3 BASE, 4 SD, 5 REG. That mode is stored with the program and cannot be changed later — only assigned when you create the program. Editing an existing slot skips this menu.

items: MODE → 6 → 1 → unused slot (e.g. 1 if P1 is empty)
1 (COMP) or 2 (CMPLX) — or ▶ then 3 / 4 / 5 for BASE / SD / REG
MODE → 6 → 1 → 1 on an existing P1 opens the editor with no run-mode prompt
